arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_flags.py << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels, definitions=None, timeout_ms=5, seed='s'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}

def case(name, frames=None, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames or [],
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}

def hf(pairs, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [[k, v] for k, v in pairs], 'End_Stream': end}

def df(data, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': data, 'End_Stream': end}

def gf(data):
    return {'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': data}

def chan(name, parts):
    return {'name': name, 'parts': [{'case': o, 'data': d} for o, d in parts]}

R = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"          # matches expect GET /a h
R2 = "POST /b HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n"        # mismatched
R_NOHOST = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"
R_TWOHOST = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"

# ---- unattributed --------------------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, R)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('unattributed flag', rec['flags'] == ['unattributed'], rec['flags'])
check('unattributed owner', rec['owner'] is None and rec['owners'] == [[None, len(R)]])
check('unattributed case', r['cases'][0]['origin_count'] == 0 and r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['missing_origin'])

# ---- identity ok / mismatch ----------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/b', host='x')],
                [], [chan('z', [('c', R)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('identity mismatch', rec['flags'] == ['identity'], rec['flags'])
check('identity case flag', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['identity'], r['cases'][0]['flags'])

for name, req, kw in [
    ('method mismatch', R2, {}),
    ('target mismatch', "GET /zz HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n", {}),
    ('host mismatch', "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: zzz\r\n\r\n", {}),
]:
    r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [('c', req)])]))
    rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
    check('identity ' + name, 'identity' in rec['flags'], rec['flags'])

# host case folding matches
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], host='H.ExAmPlE')],
                [], [chan('z', [('c', "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('identity host folded', 'identity' not in rec['flags'], rec['flags'])
check('host fp lowercased', rec['host'] == fp(b'h.example'), rec['host'])

# missing/multiple host => identity too
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [('c', R_NOHOST)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('missing_host flags', rec['flags'] == ['identity', 'missing_host'], rec['flags'])
check('missing_host case', 'identity' in r['cases'][0]['flags'])
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [('c', R_TWOHOST)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('multiple_host flags', rec['flags'] == ['identity', 'multiple_host'], rec['flags'])
check('multiple host count', rec['host_count'] == 2 and rec['host'] == fp(b''), rec['host_count'])

# ---- mixed_owner ----------------------------------------------------------
n1 = len("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHo")
r = run_obj(doc([case('c1', [hf([('x','y')])]), case('c2', [hf([('x','y')])])],
                [], [chan('z', [('c1', "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHo"), ('c2', "st: h\r\n\r\n")])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('mixed_owner flag', rec['flags'] == ['mixed_owner'], rec['flags'])
check('mixed owners list', rec['owners'] == [['c1', n1], ['c2', len(R)-n1]], rec['owners'])
check('mixed case flags', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['mixed_origin'] and r['cases'][0]['origin_count'] == 1,
      r['cases'][0]['flags'])
check('mixed non-first owner', r['cases'][1]['flags'] == [] and r['cases'][1]['origin_count'] == 0)

# owners merged for equal labels interleaved with zero-length parts
seg = len("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n")
r = run_obj(doc([case('c1', [hf([('x','y')])])],
                [], [chan('z', [('c1', "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n"), (None, ''), ('c1', "Host: h\r\n\r\n")])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('owners merge', rec['owners'] == [['c1', seg], [None, 0+0]][:1] + ([['c1', len(R)-seg]] if False else []) or rec['owners'] == [['c1', len(R)]], rec['owners'])
check('owner first byte', rec['owner'] == 'c1')

# owners ordered by first occurrence (c2 first)
a = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n"
b = "\r\n"
r = run_obj(doc([case('c1', [hf([('x','y')])]), case('c2', [hf([('x','y')])])],
                [], [chan('z', [('c2', a), ('c1', b)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('owners first-occurrence order', rec['owners'] == [['c2', len(a)], ['c1', len(b)]], rec['owners'])
check('owner is first byte', rec['owner'] == 'c2' and r['cases'][1]['origin_count'] == 1)

# ---- extra ----------------------------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])],
                [], [chan('z', [('c', R), ('c', R)]), chan('y', [('c', R)])]))
reqs = r['channels'][0]['requests'] + r['channels'][1]['requests']
check('extra on 2nd and 3rd', reqs[0]['flags'] == [] and reqs[1]['flags'] == ['extra'] and
      reqs[2]['flags'] == ['extra'], [q['flags'] for q in reqs])
check('extra_origin case', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['extra_origin'] and r['cases'][0]['origin_count'] == 3)

# ---- unsent ---------------------------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [gf('d')])], [], [chan('z', [('c', R)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('unsent request flag', rec['flags'] == ['unsent'], rec['flags'])
check('unsent_origin case', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['unsent_origin'], r['cases'][0]['flags'])

# zero-frame case owning a request
r = run_obj(doc([case('c')], [], [chan('z', [('c', R)])]))
check('zero-frame unsent', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['unsent_origin'])

# ---- missing_origin with request_frames but no request ---------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, R)])]))
check('missing_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'] == ['missing_origin'])

# sorted flag sets
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [('c', R2)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('flags sorted', rec['flags'] == sorted(rec['flags']))

summary()
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_flags.py
